messages.subject: Re: User interface is slow
messages.body_plain:
I think this is because of the R version that you are using, some old versions of R does not show any drivers. Solution: If this is the case, just install the latedt version of R (Note: then you need to set the global option in R studio that It is using the R version you just installed and install all dependency R packaged)
